titration_frequency.value: once per position (supine and prone), after each recruitment maneuver, with 30-min equilibration before measurement

provenance.quote: The identified PEEP with the lowest Estat,RS (PEEPEstat,RS) was set after a recruitment maneuver, and a complete measurement of respiratory mechanics, gas exchange, and hemodynamics was performed after a 30-min equilibration period. After a recruitment maneuver as described, PEEP was set to the Ptpexp target... After a 30-min equilibration period, complete measurement of respiratory mechanics, gas exchange, and hemodynamics was performed.

recruitment_manoeuvre_detail.value: PEEP was slowly increased to 35 cm H2O in a pressure-controlled mode with a Pdriv of 15 cm H2O over a period of 5 min. After 2 min, ventilator mode was switched back to a volume-controlled mode using the initial VT and RR.

provenance.quote: PEEP was slowly increased to 35 cm H2O in a pressure-controlled mode with a Pdriv of 15 cm H2O over a period of 5 min. After 2 min, ventilator mode was switched back to a volume-controlled mode using the initial VT and RR to perform a decremental PEEP trial.
The patients were ventilated in a volume-controlled mode with tidal volumes (VT) of 6 mL/kg predicted body weight and respiratory rates (RR) to achieve a pHa of 7.25.

other_co_interventions.value: Sedation with midazolam (5–15 mg/h) and sufentanil (30–40 µg/h) to RASS −5; continuous cisatracurium; norepinephrine if MAP < 65 mmHg despite preload optimization.

provenance.quote: All patients were sedated with midazolam (5–15 mg/h) and sufentanil (30–40 µg/h) to achieve a Richmond Agitation-Sedation Score of − 5 [22]. Cisatracurium was infused continuously for neuromuscular blockade throughout the study period. Norepinephrine was administered if MAP was below 65 mmHg despite preload optimization.

timing_verbatim.value: Measurements performed during a single study session after enrolment; patients already invasively ventilated in the ICU.

provenance.quote: After obtaining written informed consent from each patient or their relatives, 40 consecutive patients with moderate to severe ARDS... were studied.

duration_of_pes_guidance.value: single session: PEEP_Ptpexp applied in supine position and again in prone position, each after a recruitment maneuver and 30-min equilibration

comparator_verbatim.value: (A) ARDS Network recommendations (PEEPARDSNetwork), (B) the lowest static elastance of the respiratory system (PEEPEstat,RS), and (C) targeting a positive Ptpexp (PEEPPtpexp).

provenance.quote: protective ventilation with PEEP titrated according to three different titration strategies was evaluated during supine and prone positioning: (A) ARDS Network recommendations (PEEPARDSNetwork), (B) the lowest static elastance of the respiratory system (PEEPEstat,RS), and (C) targeting a positive Ptpexp (PEEPPtpexp).

crossover_order.value: Fixed, non-randomised sequence: supine ARDSNetwork → supine Estat,RS → supine Ptpexp → prone ARDSNetwork → prone Estat,RS → prone Ptpexp. 'The non-randomized sequence of positioning and PEEP titration strategies may influence the results due to the longitudinal design with repeated measurements.'

subgroup_flags.classification_notes: ards_only: enrolment required moderate to severe ARDS (PaO2/FiO2 < 150). obesity_subgroup unclear: demographic data including BMI are in Additional file 1 Table S3, not in the main text. timing_subgroup unclear: measurements performed in a single session after enrolment; no interval from intubation/ICU admission/ARDS onset reported. ptp_target_subgroups: the PEEPPtpexp strategy targets positive end-expiratory Ptp (absolute Pes subtraction, EPVent-2 table); the ARDSNetwork table and lowest-Estat,RS strategies are not transpulmonary-pressure targets and are coded 'other'.

extraction_flags.overlap_evidence: COHORTS.md suspects boesing_2022 (n=40) and boesing_2024a (n=55) share the Mannheim centre and a supine/prone esophageal-pressure-guided protocol. Confirmed from this report: single centre (University Medical Centre Mannheim), same group (Krebs/Luecke), same PEEP titration strategies, enrolment July 2019 to February 2021, DRKS00017449. Whether the 2024 sample subsumes these 40 patients cannot be settled from this report alone; the 2024 report's enrolment window and registration must be compared. Provisionally treated as the same cohort pending that check.
unclear_items: intervention.peep_titration_target.end_expiratory_ptp_target_low_cmh2o / high_cmh2o: numeric Ptpexp targets are in Additional file 1 Table S2 (EPVent-2 empirical table), not in the main text; not accessible here.
outcomes Ptpexp and Ptpinsp under PEEPPtpexp, and PEEP, Pplat, Pdriv under PEEPARDSNetwork: values shown only in Figures 2A, 2B, 3A, 3B, 4A; would require digitisation.
population demographics (age, sex, BMI, SAPS II, SOFA values): reported only in Additional file 1 Table S3, not in the main text.
feasibility fields: no report of balloon placement success, failures, or complications anywhere in the main text.
adults_18_plus: explicit exclusion of age < 18 years stated, so coded yes; no upper-age issue.
